name: Fleabane Cochylid
desc: Fleabane Cochylid (Eugnosta erigeronana): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Eugnosta erigeronana, the fleabane cochylid moth, is a species of moth of the family Tortricidae. It is found from Texas and Oklahoma, east to Florida, north to North Carolina and west to Illinois.
